title: Solving Robust POMDPs with Omega-regular Objectives via Partially Observable Stochastic Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.24986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Robust POMDPs (RPOMDPs) generalize classical POMDPs to the setting where exact transition probabilities are not known -- rather, they are only known to belong to some uncertainty set of values. In this work, we study the problem of solving RPOMDPs with general omega-regular objectives, which subsume a broad class of objectives such as reachability, safety, and linear temporal logic (LTL) objectives. We show that, for (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, the problem of solving RPOMDPs under omega-regular objectives can be reduced to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs) under omega-regular objectives. Moreover, we show for the first time that reductions can be constructed in both directions, establishing the semantic equivalence between (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets and POSGs. translated_title: 通过部分可观测随机博弈求解具有Omega-正则目标的鲁棒POMDP
translated_abstract: 鲁棒POMDP（RPOMDP）将经典POMDP推广到了精确转移概率未知的设定——转移概率仅已知属于某个不确定集合中的值。在本工作中，我们研究了求解具有一般omega-正则目标的RPOMDP的问题，该类目标涵盖了广泛的多种目标，例如可达性、安全性以及线性时序逻辑（LTL）目标。我们证明，对于具有多面体不确定集的(s,a)-矩形RPOMDP，在omega-正则目标下求解RPOMDP的问题可以归约为在omega-正则目标下求解部分可观测随机博弈（POSG）的问题。此外，我们首次证明了这种归约可以双向构造，从而建立了具有多面体不确定集的(s,a)-矩形RPOMDP与POSG之间的语义等价性。这使得我们能够推导出一系列新的计算复杂性结果，包括上界……
tldr: 本文首次证明了具有多面体不确定集的(s,a)-矩形鲁棒POMDP与部分可观测随机博弈（POSG）在omega-正则目标下可双向归约、语义等价，从而推导出一系列新的计算复杂性结果。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes, for the first time, bidirectional reductions and semantic equivalence between (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets and partially observable stochastic games under omega-regular objectives, deriving a range of new computational complexity results.
